function: Deep-unfolded BCD: DECA network predicts the MM parameter xi that sets IRS phase-shift updates, maximizing weighted sum rate in an IRS-aided MIMO-WPCN (p. 8).
system: IRS-aided MIMO-WPCN: PS 32 antennas, MS 8, four devices with 2 antennas, passive reflecting IRS of 20-70 elements; frequency band not stated (p. 3, 10, 11).
method: Deep unfolding: unrolled BCD (12 outer, 6 inner MM layers) with DECA CNN-attention network; unsupervised training on weighted sum-rate loss (p. 7-10).
data_channel: Custom simulator: Rayleigh fading with path-loss exponents 2.2 (IRS links) and 3.6; 20000 training and 10000 test samples; no 3GPP model or measurements (p. 10).
test_conditions: Trained at -90 dBm noise, tested without retraining at -85 and -80 dBm (Fig. 12); also 10000 test samples and imperfect CSI (p. 10, 13).
baselines: Non-learned: AO with price-mechanism MM [51], Random-IRS, Non-IRS, proposed BCD. Learned: CNN-BCD and FC-BCD unfolding networks (p. 10-11).
metrics: Weighted sum rate (bps/Hz), efficiency ratio to BCD, CPU running time, convergence epochs, training time, inference time (p. 11-13).
complexity: CPU time for N=20-70: DECA-BCD 10.2-16.3 ms, AO 178-427 ms, BCD 74-10498 s (Table II, p. 12); orders of complexity of BCD steps (p. 6).
q1_support: p. 10: "we assume that all the channel links follow Rayleigh fading" - custom simulator with path-loss exponents 2.2 and 3.6; no 3GPP, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured data.
q2_support: p. 13: "deployed without retraining, achieves sum-rate performance closely matching that of models trained specifically at higher noise levels" (Fig. 12), and "Similar robust generalization behavior is also observed under variations in user density".
q3_support: p. 11: "The DECA-BCD outperforms all benchmark schemes, including CNN-BCD, FC-BCD, and AO" - sum-rate comparison (Fig. 7) with learned CNN-BCD and FC-BCD and non-learned AO, Random-IRS and Non-IRS defined on p. 10.
q4_support: p. 12: "The runtimes of the three primary algorithms considered are listed in Table II" - CPU time of DECA-BCD, AO and BCD; orders of complexity in Sec. III-C (p. 6).
q5_support: p. 10: "The training and testing datasets contain 20000 and 10000 channel samples, respectively" - generated with its own simulator; no link to code or data, no public dataset.
notes: Included as deep unfolding with trained parameters: the DECA network predicts xi, which sets the IRS phase update inside the unrolled BCD (p. 8), so area 3 (RIS configuration with the BS-side precoders); the loss is the weighted sum rate (p. 9). q1=0: Rayleigh custom simulator. q2=1 rests on the noise-power transfer test (Fig. 12, p. 13), close to an SNR sweep, plus the stated robustness to user density and L0 (p. 13) without a figure; the reviewer may confirm. q3=1: CNN-BCD and FC-BCD are standard architectures placed in the same unfolding frame, which could be read as variants of the proposed network; AO, Random-IRS and Non-IRS are non-learned. q4=1 from the Table II runtimes (p. 12). q5=0: no release.
